newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Fire bomb hurled at U.S. consulate in Indonesia.
newsitem.headline: Fire bomb hurled at U.S. consulate in Indonesia.

text.p: A fire bomb was thrown over the fence into the grounds of the U.S. Consulate-General in Indonesia's second largest city of Surabaya but no one was hurt, a mission official said on Wednesday.
Craig Stromme, U.S. embassy spokesman in Jakarta, 700 km (430 miles) west of Surabaya, confirmed the Tuesday morning attack.
"Somebody threw a molotov cocktail over the fence and it went into the parking lot. It didn't hit anybody or anything," Stromme said.
He said there was no immediate explanation for the attack or any information on those responsible.
